title: Fractional translation iterates and exact prime-power periods
statement: Let p be prime, let a,j be natural numbers with 1 ≤ j < a, and let z ∈ R = Z/(p^a)Z satisfy p^j | z.val and p^(j+1) ∤ z.val. Define F(w) = w(1+w)⁻¹ using the ZMod inverse. For every natural number n, 1+nz is a unit, F^n(z) = z(1+nz)⁻¹, F^n(z) = z if and only if p^(a−2j) divides n, and F^n(z) still has exact valuation j: p^j divides its canonical representative and p^(j+1) does not. The exponent a−2j is truncated natural subtraction.
lean_statement: ∀ (p a j : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ j → j < a → ∀ z : ZMod (p ^ a), p ^ j ∣ z.val → ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ z.val → let F : ZMod (p ^ a) → ZMod (p ^ a) := fun w => w * (1 + w)⁻¹; ∀ n : ℕ, IsUnit (1 + (n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z) ∧ (F^[n]) z = z * (1 + (n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z)⁻¹ ∧ ((F^[n]) z = z ↔ p ^ (a - 2 * j) ∣ n) ∧ p ^ j ∣ ((F^[n]) z).val ∧ ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ ((F^[n]) z).val
